confirmed_conflicts.impact: The runtime name resembles the Notes parent, while #19B requires that parent to remain container_only.

confirmed_conflicts.existing_behavior: Existing deterministic routing assigns Directors Report, Statement by Directors, statutory declaration, auditors report, and the Notes parent to template codes.
confirmed_conflicts.requested_behavior: #19B requires those report sections to be narrative_only and the Notes parent to be container_only.

missing_canonical_metadata: technical/internal name beyond the six-digit code
reproduction: Load XBRLTemplateService and print descriptions for 730000, 740000, and 750000.
Inspect the matching role definitions in the bundled MPERS role XSD.
Inspect the first concept in each matching mpers_templates.json entry.
Observe that runtime descriptions for 740000 and 750000 contradict both taxonomy roles and concepts.
remediation_direction: Keep XBRLTemplateService/mpers_templates.json authoritative for the exact 24 IDs, concepts, and role URIs.
Reconcile semantic names against the bundled taxonomy roles and concepts with explicit compatibility aliases for existing persisted runtime names.
Resolve narrative/container policy separately from inventory membership.
Publish one versioned inventory-card adapter and hash both structural inventory and reconciled semantic metadata.
Add exact-24, unique-ID, role/concept consistency, compatibility, API, mapping, and Review Workspace regressions.

decision.recommended_next_feature: 19B-blocker-1 - Reconcile the canonical internal template-group inventory
